what: HTTP requests per day for a zone
title: Cloudflare website analytics
text: httpRequests1hGroups (hourly bins) httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups (sampled adaptive bins) follow shape.
code: zones <- cf_list_zones(max_pages = 1) zone_id <- zones[[1]]$id  query <- "   query ZoneRequests($zoneTag: String!, $since: Date!, $until: Date!) {     viewer {       zones(filter: { zoneTag: $zoneTag }) {         httpRequests1dGroups(           limit: 100,           filter: { date_geq: $since, date_lt: $until },           orderBy: [date_ASC]         ) {           dimensions { date }           sum {             requests             bytes             pageViews             threats           }           uniq { uniques }         }       }     }   } "  res <- cf_graphql(   query,   zoneTag = zone_id,   since   = format(Sys.Date() - 7, "%Y-%m-%d"),   until   = format(Sys.Date(),     "%Y-%m-%d") )  days <- res$data$viewer$zones[[1]]$httpRequests1dGroups data.frame(   date     = vapply(days, function(d) d$dimensions$date, character(1)),   requests = vapply(days, function(d) d$sum$requests,    integer(1)),   bytes    = vapply(days, function(d) d$sum$bytes,       numeric(1)),   pageviews = vapply(days, function(d) d$sum$pageViews,  integer(1)),   uniques  = vapply(days, function(d) d$uniq$uniques,    integer(1)) )

title: cloudflarer 0.0.0.9000
text: cf_verify() longer crashes NA--error credentials configured. now falls /user underlying credential helpers raise documented “Cloudflare credentials found” message. cf_verify() honours credential precedence request layer: explicitly-passed email/api_key now verify /user even CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN present environment, instead silently verifying env token. cf_records_to_df() longer silently truncates numeric data records mix integer double values field. Mixed integer + double columns widen double; otherwise incompatible mixed scalar types fall back list-column. Classed scalar values (Date, POSIXct) kept list-column rather stripped bare numerics. cf_records_to_df() validates records list named lists aborts clear message otherwise. cf_zone_overview() now swallows cloudflarer_error conditions per documented contract. Programmer errors unexpected exceptions propagate instead silently reduced NULL. Every endpoint wrapper interpolates identifier URL path now validates identifier via new internal cf_check_id() helper, replacing confusing API routing errors single useful message. Boolean Cloudflare query parameters now serialized consistently internal cf_query_bool() helper, boolean flags sent TRUE (example enabled_only, verified_only) validated front shared cf_check_flag() helper bad input raises clear, argument-named message everywhere. Endpoint wrappers longer assemble request paths paste0(). wrapper passes path character vector segments (c("zones", zone_id, "dns_records")) appended httr2::req_url_path_append(), every segment URL-encoded httr2 rather string-concatenated. format_graphql_error() escapes braces assembling full message, brace appearing GraphQL path segment can longer confuse cli’s interpolation. Response-envelope access uses [["result"]] instead $result, avoiding R’s partial name matching result_info unusual case envelope omits result. legacy Global API Key auth path (X-Auth-Email/ X-Auth-Key) now redacts headers via httr2::req_headers_redacted(), matching protection cf_req_auth() already gave bearer tokens. Previously, printing dry-running request built email + key credentials leaked Global API Key plain text. cf_firewall_events_top() cf_rum_top() validate dimension new internal cf_check_dimension_name() helper splicing underlying GraphQL query. dimension must single GraphQL field name collide fixed metric column (events/count); previously unvalidated dimension interpolated verbatim query text, caller-controlled value (example one forwarded Shiny input code built top package) break intended selection set request additional fields. Breaking: cf_zone_overview() now returns zone_id, since, ordinary list elements instead object attributes, ’re accessed way every component (ov$zone_id rather attr(ov, "zone_id")).

title: cloudflarer 0.0.0.9000
text: Composable request layer built httr2. cf_request() builds authenticated request endpoint returns ; callers pipe httr2 verbs need (req_method(), req_url_query(), req_body_json()), perform , unwrap Cloudflare envelope cf_resp(). cf_collect() walks paginated list endpoint request. lets users mix package’s helpers plain httr2 call anything package wrap, instead routing everything one argument-heavy function. Two-mode authentication: API token via CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, legacy Global API Key via CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL + CLOUDFLARE_API_KEY. active mode reported cf_auth_mode(). Authentication helpers: cf_token(), cf_email(), cf_api_key(), cf_has_auth(), cf_token_verify(), cf_verify(). Diagnostic helper cf_sitrep() reports active mode verifies configured credentials live API. REST API failures reach API, whether HTTP-level envelope-level (success: false), raise classed cloudflarer_error condition can caught tryCatch(). Transport-level failures (DNS, connection refused, timeout) surface underlying httr2 error.
